Several snippets ([8], [11], [14], [15], [16]) describe the general DEB mechanisms by which growth can decrease — via reduced assimilation (energy uptake) or increased maintenance costs (energy dissipation) — which is mechanistically consistent with how hypoxia could plausibly act, but they do not invoke DO as the driver. Thus the corpus offers no direct evidence for or against the DO-specific stylized fact; support is weak and only mechanistically analogous, with no contradicting evidence.
